newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to act decisively on forex excess - Sakabibara.
newsitem.headline: Japan to act decisively on forex excess - Sakabibara.

text.p: Japan will deal with excessive movements in the currency market decisively and in a timely way, senior Ministry of Finance (MOF) official Eisuke Sakakibara said on Friday.
Any excessive rise or fall in the yen's value is undesirable, he told the Lower House of parliament's finance committee.

"As Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka has said, our basic stance is that we will find appropriate timing to deal with excessive currency movements decisively. Neither an excessive fall nor rise in the yen is desirable," said Sakakibara, who is head of the ministry's International Finance Bureau.
Sakakibara said Japan is keeping in close daily contact with other members of the Group of Seven (G7) industrial nations regarding exchange rate movements.
